bgfx / bimg / bx — rendering backend, vendored as three sibling trees.

Upstream:    https://github.com/bkaradzic/bgfx  (+ bimg, bx as siblings)
Version:     bgfx rev 9149 (2026-09-03, commit 7bb7a9f7; old GLSL 120 / ESSL
             default / DX9 profiles were removed upstream at this rev)
License:     BSD 2-clause (bgfx/LICENSE; bimg and bx carry the same license)
Vendored:    updated via Tools/update_bgfx.py — clone the three repos as
             siblings of this repo, run the script, then expect to fix build
             breaks and regenerate embedded shaders
Build:       External/bgfx/CMakeLists.txt + shaderc.cmake are engine-authored
             build scripts modeled after bkaradzic/bgfx.cmake; shaderc links
             Dawn's Tint for WGSL — do not strip the tint target. Every
             desktop platform compiles its native renderer (Metal / D3D11 /
             Vulkan) alongside WebGPU so apps still run without the dawn
             library; keep that fallback when touching the renderer defines
Consumed by: Graphics/ (renderer, textures, effects, embedded shaders),
             Tools/compile_shader.py via shaderc (prebuilt Tools/bin/shaderc
             on Windows/Linux x64, or Tools/bin/shaderc.local built with the
             unix-shaderc / windows-shaderc presets)
Note:        bgfx's own tools/bin/*/.gitignore (`*`) hides the runtime
             binaries upstream force-adds (dxcompiler/dxil/d3dcompiler_47 and
             the Linux .so twins); shaderc's POST_BUILD copy needs them, so
             they are force-tracked here too — after re-running
             update_bgfx.py, restore them with `git add -f`.
